games.name: BLACK STACK
games.summary: THE SURVEILLANCE METER IS THE REAL BOSSThe Black Stack is a sentient corporate megastructure that placed divinity behind a permission gate.You are unauthorized.Build a forbidden deck. Steal hardware. Compile one-shot exploits. Climb toward the process that wrote God - and decide how much evidence to leave behind.Protocols raise TRACE, which persists between encounters and crosses PING, LOCK, PURGE, and TERMINAL thresholds. Each arms a new response. High Trace distorts the interface and enemy intent; at 100, one grace cycle precedes escalating nonlethal Integrity loss. Vent it - or turn surveillance into fuel.COMPILE YOUR OWN VERSIONChoose from three playable identities, each with a distinct body, starting kit, card pool, and power:VANTA // THE APOSTATE - disciplined Bandwidth and Trace control through OVERCLOCK.THE ARCHON KERNEL - stolen authority that turns dangerous Trace into power.THE COURIER - a script-runner whose exploit inventory drives the deck.The catalog contains 503 card definitions: 496 playable protocols and seven hostile Status injections. Build across Attacks, Skills, Powers, and 60 dedicated WAGER protocols. The wider library adds 78 relics, 66 exploit scripts, 16 Divine elixirs, 12 Ultras, five Graft Cores, and 12 Machine God blessings.POWER LEAVES A SIGNALAcross 496 playable protocols and 172 relics, scripts, elixirs, and Ultras, dozens of engines are waiting to be discovered - and broken open.Power earned through play is allowed to feel powerful. We do not flatten an engine merely because it became obscene. Your LOADOUT SIGNAL lets Intelligent difficulty read rarity, mastery, equipment, and graft investment, then scale the Stack around you. Prefer a ceiling? Select Capped response. Add one of three Audit contracts for greater resistance and rewards.PHYSICAL COPIES. PERMANENT MASTERY.Recover schematics, spend Salvage to compile as many physical copies as you can afford, and build a ten-card opening manifest for each identity. Removed starters return to your library.Basic through Rare protocols reach level 3; Divine protocols reach level 4.Rare capstones and every Divine rank fork permanently, so copies of one card can become different weapons.Maxed cards gain animated mastery chrome and rarity-aware play effects.Wager protocols turn coin calls, dice, loaded reels, Blackjack, and roulette into seeded combat engines with bespoke animations.SIX ACTS TO ROOT TERMINUSClimb a branching, seeded ascent through five atlases, then enter ROOT TERMINUS: a straight eight-layer procession toward Archon Prime and its Ascendant second body.Face 81 hostile processes and 58 authored event definitions, including eight adaptive Forensic Processes.Fight multi-enemy encounters with individual intents and direct targeting.Hunt elite variants and confront bespoke authorities - including one you can negotiate with.At Archon checkpoints, repair, vent, extract a prize, or continue deeper.Use REVOCATION once per run to reject a filed death and return at 1 HP and 0 Trace. The enemy's exact Integrity, Block, status, form, and intent remain; every player card returns to the deck.ACCEPT THE MANDATE - OR REVOKE ITA forbidden offer can transform your identity and unlock THE MANDATE: a second six-act campaign that turns the route inside out and sends you against ten new authorities.Protect the system you once breached, pursue older powers, or revoke your appointment and return to the oath. The Archive remembers which version chose.THE STACK LEARNS HOW YOU FIGHTCombat Doctrine records your openers, sequences, Bandwidth use, defense, targets, Trace appetite, wagers, and equipment. The Stack uses those habits in Forensic Processes - and when archived versions return.Failed and strongest selves can rebuild their real deck, mastery branches, equipment, resources, piles, and learned doctrine. The most dangerous encounter may be the version that mastered your own engine first.DESCEND BELOW THE STACKA route can fracture into the DEEP BREACH, a rare once-per-run exception that suspends your exact atlas and opens an eight-stop illegal descent.Three authorities. Two corrupted casinos. A Divine cache. An apex boss. Extraction.Escape and the original atlas reconnects where it broke, contraband intact. Die below the Stack and the run ends. Complete a naturally filed descent to recover the secret Godscar Engine Graft Core.THE BLACK ARCHIVE REMEMBERS EVERY VERSIONRecovery Catalog + Workbench - unlock and compile components, construct manifests, and master individual copies.Graft Foundry - install one of five cores and commit to one of 15 doctrines across 150 authored nodes. Reset for a full Salvage refund.The Ascent - infinite, non-seasonal progression. Complete twelve-node chapters for Gems and new deterministic reward lines.Breach Archive + Memory Index - reopen run maps and telemetry; catalog encountered processes, origins, art, and lore.NULLCADE - two permanent cabinets: BREACHEROIDS and the seven-stage NULLSPIRE, with persistent scores and bounded rewards.THE HOUSE ALWAYS COLLECTSWager Dens select deterministic Blackjack or an animated 3x3 reel machine. Between runs, spend earned Gems at Big Six for XP, Salvage, property, or an unowned Divine protocol. Every stake uses fictional currency earned only through play.ONE PRICE. THE COMPLETE GAME.Everything here is included in one purchase and earned through play.No microtransactions, paid currency, card packs, paid battle pass, loot boxes, real-money wagering, or cash-out.SHARED RULES. YOUR DECISIONS.Every run is deterministic; share a BREACH CODE to replay its route.SCHEDULED AUDITS are seeded challenges with fixed identity, kit, route, and modifier.A guided tutorial teaches combat, Trace, Block, the Archive, deck construction, mastery, grafts, and loadouts.Save and resume route and combat state, with Steam Cloud reconciliation.BUILT FOR THE WHOLE RUN60 Steam achievements and 31 interface languages.Keyboard, mouse, and gamepad navigation.Separate audio, display, atmosphere, post FX, shake, impact, and reduced-motion settings.Card inspection, forecasts, reactive music, cinematics, hit-stop, shield fractures, kill dissolves, particles, and atmosphere.The Stack is generating another version of you.

games.name: Pitchside Empire

Pretty soon you'll be answering crazy questions--careful, many are designed to trip you up! Can you figure out the sometimes oblique answers (and do you know what oblique means)? If you can puzzle out these mind-benders, you'll get a high IQ score and impress your friends.Features:- 45 fun, addicting stages- Checkpoints in each section of the quiz- Beautiful hand drawn graphics- Compare and test it with your friends! Fun for all ages

games.name: Stillflow
games.summary: Rotate minimalist lines and connect every port across 100 calm, handcrafted puzzles.

games.name: Tarot Gambit
games.summary: Tarot Gambit is a 1v1 tarot duel against the Devil. Draw blindly: each Arcana brings healing or sudden death. Use relics to spy, sabotage, and turn the tables. In endless mode, bet chips each round — lose them all and you're out, or cash out anytime. A candlelit battle of memory, nerve, and bluff.

games.name: 빈 칸을 채워줘#1 : 백지 위를 뒹구는 하얀 퍼즐들
7 Deaths 1 Life
games.summary: "Welcome, player. You have been chosen to take part in a very special game."7 Deaths - 1 Life is a psychological suspense visual novel that confronts you with an impossible dilemma. A mysterious hooded figure named Karma has kidnapped 8 people in an abandoned prison, and you will decide their fate.Over the course of 7 acts, you will listen to their stories, learn about their sins, their fears, and their reasons. And you will choose the order in which they are executed. There is no turning back. There is no salvation for everyone. Only one will make it out alive.Characters- Esther (26 years old): Prostitute and madam. She defends the legality of her work and its necessity.- Mark (22 years old): Wealthy and immature young man. His life was cut short after running over two people while driving drunk.- Christie (18 years old): High school bully. She spends her classes mocking her classmates and making their lives impossible.- Andrew (41 years old): Homeless man scraping by on the streets after abandoning his family. No one is waiting for him anymore.- Rose (20 years old): Vigilante serial killer. She has already murdered four abusers who mistreated their partners.- David (24 years old): Former medical student and drug addict. He is incapable of giving up the very thing that is destroying his life.- Sarah (19 years old): Fine arts student with severe depression. She has attempted suicide twice and no longer believes she can be saved.- Richard (17 years old): Street delinquent. Theft, drug trafficking, beatings — any kind of crime you can think of.- Karma: The hooded figure orchestrating this macabre game. Sadistic, manipulative, and convinced that his victims deserve to die.Key Features- An intense and provocative story: Each character represents a real social stigma — prostitution, bullying, addiction, domestic violence, suicide, delinquency... — treated with rawness and psychological depth.- Morally weighted decisions: This is not about right or wrong, but about confronting your own prejudices. Every death makes you an accomplice. Every choice defines you.- Only one save slot: Your decisions are final. There is no going back.- Replayability: Although the story structure is linear, the order in which characters live or die changes the dialogue. Complete the game to unlock fast-forward and explore every possible combination.- 9 Steam achievements: Discover them all as you progress through this unforgettable experience.- Translated into 4 languages: English, Spanish, Chinese, and Portuguese.Content WarningThis game deals with adult themes and contains depictions of death, violence, suicide, sexual abuse, drugs, and high emotional tension. It is not recommended for people sensitive to this content.Estimated DurationA full playthrough lasts between 1 and 2 hours.Developed byMario Picó Busquier, with illustrations by Maria Fornovi, under the IcarusFlight label.

games.name: After Work (Wenvio)
games.summary: After Work is a short, atmospheric first-person exploration game. The workday is over and it's time to head home. But a familiar way out begins to lead somewhere unfamiliar, gradually taking you further from the ordinary.

games.name: An Unknown Land
games.summary: Explore a mysterious island, gather resources, manage your flashlight and oil lamp, evade terrifying creatures, and survive as long as possible in this atmospheric single-player survival adventure.

games.name: Asking the Way in a Long Song
games.summary: “没有挂机，没有轻松——国风硬核修仙，胜者飞升！”踏入《 问道长歌》，进入一个真正的残酷修仙世界！没有自动寻路，也没有满屏逼氪，一切靠操作与策略说话。探索上古遗迹、夺取神秘法宝、与仙魔妖兽殊死搏斗——弱者被淘汰，强者独占巅峰。真实战斗、残酷争夺、自由冒险，这里只有敢于挑战极限的修仙者才能飞升成仙，体验硬核非凡修仙！

games.name: Backpack Inspector
games.summary:
Fantasy customs officer simulator. Decide the fate of the heroes who want to get into the kingdom, on whose guard you stand. Check their backpacks for forbidden artifacts, stolen items, and contraband.

Be watchful, for the glory of the crown!

games.name: Breathedge 2
games.summary:
Sent on a reckless mission, you find yourself in outer space filled with numerous dangers and things to explore. Build, craft, manage your crew, look after the chicken, and defeat the evil space corporation in this new breathtaking survival game.

Breathedge 2 is an ironic retro-futuristic space survival game that continues the story of the Man facing epic intergalactic problems. Together with your irreplaceable companions, try to put an end to the Breathedge Corporation without dying or going crazy in the process.

games.name: ChimpUP!
games.summary:
ChimpUP! is a chaotic co-op climbing party game where you and your friends race and play minigames. 

Armed with two independent grapple hooks for arms, you and up to three other chimp friends compete in races across a fast paced maps with gimmicks. 

Master the swing action, collect the bananas and satisfy your urge!

games.name: Command Doctrine
games.summary: Describe a battle and AI builds it. Describe a war and get a whole campaign. Command Doctrine is a turn-based wargame with endless generated scenarios. Command armies across seven eras and outthink your enemy with supply, morale and terrain. Will your doctrine hold?

games.name: Costa Nostra
games.summary: A persistent criminal strategy MMO: choose one of six factions, conquer 336 zones across three regions, and build an empire through economy, money laundering, influence, logistics, real-time operations, and territorial PvP wars.

games.name: Cubiciousflage
games.summary: Cube Hunting is a multiplayer game of disguise and full creative freedom. Hide as any prop in the world, or build your own from scratch with the in-game 3D cube builder. Break cubes block-by-block in real-time destruction. Edit, hide, hunt, build custom levels.

games.name: EONA
games.summary:
Play as Eona, a young girl cursed through both her soul and her puppet. Do your best to escape this dark castle with the Puppeteer’s Cross - a legendary artifact you stole. It is your only means of defense, and the only thing that can save your sick mother.

Fail, and you will suffer the same fate as countless innocent souls before you.

games.name: Gravity Knight
games.summary: Gravity Knight is a 3D, third-person puzzle platforming game that requires you to manipulate gravity and complete various puzzle rooms to escape the dungeon!

Legion Hunters
games.summary:
Command your squad in a strategy-MMORPG. Unlock over 160 units and 10 races, upgrade your castle, and gear up to dominate global rankings. 

Prepare for the war to come!

games.name: Lost Light
games.summary: "In the sun's lament, the umbra takes advance and the cycle begins anew..." The sun darkens again, the world needs a brave young soul. Carry the primordial Flame of creation to the summit. Where you shall fulfill your destiny and relight the sun for the next cycle...

Find six passcard sections to gain access to a strange industrial facility that holds the secret of the natural world's malicious metamorphosis.

games.name: Scrap Snap

games.name: Serious Sam: Shatterverse
games.summary: Serious Sam: Shatterverse is a co-op roguelite FPS for 1 - 5 players. Blast through shifting universes, stack wild boons, bend the rules with run modifiers, and hunt Mental's deadliest forces. Fall fast. Come back louder.

games.name: Skullchef
games.summary: Skullchef: The Wooden Soup — a cozy idle clicker. Stir the magical cauldron, summon quirky helpers, collect hundreds of charm skins, and ascend through prestige. Relaxing ASMR vibes, daily missions, achievements and global leaderboards. English & Spanish. By SmallCreek.

games.name: Sorry, You're on the Menu
games.summary: An underwater incremental game where you catch sea creatures, unlock upgrades, and dive ever deeper into the ocean.

games.name: Sticks & Strings
games.summary: Draw, aim, and duel up to 7 other players with bows, explosive arrows, and 10 powerups. Satisfying shots, fluid movement, and multiplayer chaos. Grab your friends and prove your archery superiority!

games.name: Tabletop Galaxy
games.summary: 10 turn-based board and card games. Play, share, host, or spectate! A lobby system designed for whichever! Tweak the difficulty to play at your desired level.

games.name: The Collector's Legacy
games.summary: Discover "The Collector's Legacy" by Eagle Gaze Interactive! In a dark, Gothic library, the warm glow of a lamp reveals a chest filled with coins, artifacts, and secret parchments. A captivating collecting game and a promise of pure adventure.

games.name: The Dream Of Winning The Lottery
The Girl in the Window
games.summary:
The town of Hidden Town is scared. Very strange things are happening. Villagers claim to have seen the figure of a girl who looks out from the window of one of the houses. Which is very strange, because that house has been abandoned for 20 years.

The Girl in the Window is Dark Dome's first point and click game that would begin the series of a dark town called Hidden Town surrounded by ancient mysteries. In this escape the room suspense thriller game you play Dan, a curious guy who has entered an abandoned house and has been locked up. You will have to solve riddles and puzzles, open drawers and decipher codes, everything in your power to escape the room in this escape puzzle.

games.name: Touhou Plan of Mine ~ Rebuild the Scarlet Devil Mansion

games.summary: A cute platformer that lies to you. Fight through 60 levels of fake floors, pop-up spikes, and traitorous doors — unlock double jumps, dashes and rockets, survive monster swarms, and take down the boss. Die. Learn. Rage. Repeat.

games.name: UNLISTED
games.summary: UNLISTED is a 6–8 player social horror game set in a containment facility. Work together to restore critical systems and escape—but stay alert. Something inside can imitate a human, and the person standing next to you may not be who they claim to be.

games.name: Unnamed Pogo Game
games.summary: You lived for your pogo stick... and died by a wrecking ball. Waking up in your own grave, your only goal is to bounce your way up to Heaven! One mistake sends you straight back to the dirt. Do you have the nerves for this brutal, physics-based rage game?

Crimson Moon

Ken, a high school student, is suddenly swallowed into another world, and he decides to take desperate action to rescue his younger sister.

In this strange world illuminated by the red moon, a terrible tragedy unfolds.... A tense search and a battle to the death await you.

Isekai survival horror RPG. defeat the enemy or escape, your decision will make the difference between life and death. A horror RPG with large character dots and a death-defying storyline.

games.name: Horse Spirit Valley 2

Bringing together a talented team of developers, including members of the core team behind one of the most acclaimed games of all time - The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt along with its expansions, Rebel Wolves’ first title is a dark fantasy narrative sandbox, AAA action-RPG set in medieval Europe.

This brand-new IP is aimed at mature audiences and is powered by Unreal Engine 5.

games.name: Top Check: A Chess Card Game

Asdivine Knot
games.platforms: PS5 · Xbox · Switch 2 · Switch · PC · PS4
games.summary:
A young cleric named Verselio once devoted his life to serving the deity Treises - until the truth shattered everything he believed. 

When the divine is revealed to be a lie, faith turns into fury, and a journey of rebellion begins. Joined by a mysterious maiden, a disciplined vigilante chief, and a self-proclaimed deity, Verselio sets out across a vast fantasy world in search of answers. As their paths intertwine, each carries their own burdens, beliefs, and secrets, in a story of betrayal, redemption, and the meaning of faith in a deityless world.

Asdivine Knot is a classic turn-based JRPG that blends strategic command battles with modern systems and deep customization. Master the shared Nexus Gauge to control the flow of combat, unleash powerful Nexus Skills, and summon devastating entities to turn the tide. Explore a wide world with your fully customizable airship, craft and upgrade equipment using collected materials, and shape your adventure with side quests, crew recruitment, fishing, and puzzle dungeons. 

Packed with rich content and designed for a complete single-player experience, this is a must-play fantasy RPG for fans of traditional Japanese role-playing games.

games.name: Beetleball - The Beetle Billionaire's Deluxe Golden Scarab Supporter Pack
BioEden
games.summary:
Welcome to BioEden, a cozy management game where you will build a self-sustaining network of structures, all working in harmony to bring extinct animals back to life. As a Keeper, you have been entrusted by the Cosmic Collective to bring life back to a planet quietly waiting to be healed. 

Upon your arrival, search for debris sites scattered across the land, they are the foundation of your journey. Recycle them into resources, and use those to build the base of your network: a solar energy system to generate electricity, and a water system to distribute it across all your buildings. Connect them together, weave a network across the land, and manage the supply and demand for every structure you create.

But plan with care. Each addition to your planet consumes resources, draws on energy, and nudges pollution upward. Find the balance between creation, exploration, and restraint, to accomplish the very mission that brought you here.

games.name: Cloudgazer: A Game About Watching Clouds
Hashire Hebereke: EX
games.summary:
Hashire HEBEREKE: EX is a modern remake of the 1994 Super Famicom game Hashire Hebereke by SUNSOFT.

Players can choose from a cast of quirky and adorable characters to race through item-filled, obstacle-packed courses. Local multiplayer supports up to four players, while online multiplayer supports up to eight players, ensuring fun and frantic competition.

games.name: Marsupilami 2 - Salsa Palombia
games.summary: A strange melody has swept across Palombia… and suddenly every animal starts dancing wildly, throwing the jungle into total chaos! Behind this rhythmic madness lurks the Mummy Queen, back from the Underworld with her crew to deliver a cursed concert with devastating effects. To restore peace to the jungle, take control of the three young Marsus, each with their own signature ability. Twister shoots through the air with a turbo glide, Hope leaps forward with an energetic spinning jump, and Punch bounces with powerful force to knock aside anything in his path! Switch instantly from one Marsu to another to unleash their powers and chain together stylish moves. And for even more fun, share the adventure with a friend thanks to local co‑op mode! From the Jungle to the City, from Snowy Mountains to the mysterious Underworld…explore four enchanting worlds packed with surprises, challenges, and unique gameplay mechanics. Beyond the main adventure, take on the Flow Mode, a speed-focused challenge where you must complete a series of trials without dying to prove your skills! And for even more fun, challenge your friends in competitive dojos.

games.name: NBA 2K27
games.summary: Nothing is out of reach for Victor Wembanyama, including becoming the face of the league. The reigning Defensive Player of the Year is shattering records at an unprecedented pace, and his talent can only be described as otherworldly. The future has arrived and it’s on the cover of NBA 2K27. Caitlin Clark is changing the game with her limitless range, but it’s her will to win that’s fueled her rapid ascent from college phenom to WNBA superstar. Clark holds the all-time NCAA Division I scoring record for both men and women, is a No. 1 overall pick, Rookie of the Year, two-time All-Star, and the ultimate competitor. Take the court with NBA 2K27 Deluxe Edition and make every possession a viral highlight. He started with a dream on the South Side of Chicago, and built a legacy that inspired the world. Derrick Rose is the youngest MVP in NBA history, a three-time All-Star, an icon on and off the court, and an NBA 2K cover star. Celebrate his career with NBA 2K27 Ultra Edition and follow in his footsteps as you lead an NBA franchise.[2K Sports]

games.name: Onimusha: Way of the Sword
games.summary:
Fight through bloodstained battlefields of intense swordplay action. Explore the historic Japanese capital of Edo-era Kyoto, twisted by malevolent clouds of Malice. With every stage cloaked in mystery, danger and intrigue. Battle against monstrosities from the underworld known as Genma in a tale of dark fantasy.

Follow the tale of a samurai who wields the Oni Gauntlet, a mystical artifact that grants its bearer the power to slay Genma.

Through gritty, blood-soaked brawls, he searches for his reason to fight. What fate awaits at the end of his path?

games.name: Roads of Da Vinci: In Search of Origins
Shoe it All!
games.summary: Launch shoes from a swing to solve clever physics puzzles. Master trick shots, uncover hidden secrets and discover smarter solutions with fewer throws.

games.name: SpeedRunners 2: King of Speed
games.summary:
SpeedRunners 2: King of Speed is a fast-paced competitive platformer and a sequel to one of the most beloved indie games of the 2010s. Pick a character of your choice from a vibrant cast of eccentric superheroes, both returning and new, and face off against your rivals in frenetic running races for up to 8 players per lobby, locally or online.

The original multiplayer gameplay formula of SpeedRunners is timeless, unofficially dubbed as the ‘Mario Kart of 2D platformers’. With the sequel, our goal is to carefully bring this unique ‘SpeedRunners feel’ into the new era without compromising on the depth and fluidity of the movement system while still keeping it easy to grasp. On top of that, King of Speed introduces vibrant high-definition graphics and improved netcode.

games.name: Isle of Reveries
games.summary: Make a pilgrimage skybound to the Isle of Reveries, where any wish can be granted. Conquer mysterious dungeons, solve puzzles, and explore a vast overworld in this retro-inspired adventure.

games.name: Order Automatica
games.summary:
Order Automatica is a dark tactical roguelite where automated battles are won before they even begin.

Build deadly synergies on a small 3x3 ritual grid, position your units carefully, manipulate tiles, and prepare for brutal encounters against demonic enemies. Every move matters.

games.name: Phantom PHANTOM OF INFERNO NITRO ARCHIVE
CONTROL Resonant
games.summary:
With Control, we leaped into the unknown. We wanted to create something new. Something different and unexpected. A world like no other. 

With Control 2, we'll take another leap into the unknown. It'll be an unexpected journey.

games.name: Silent Hill: Townfall
games.summary: SILENT HILL: Townfall, a co-production with Annapurna Interactive (Stray) and multiple BAFTA award winning No Code Studios (Stories Untold, Observation).

games.name: Gears of War: E-Day
games.summary:
Experience the brutal horror of Emergence Day through the eyes of Marcus Fenix in the origin story of one of gaming's most acclaimed sagas.​ 

Fourteen years before Gears of War, war heroes Marcus Fenix and Dom Santiago return home to face a new nightmare: the Locust Horde. These subterranean monsters, grotesque and relentless, erupt from below, laying siege on humanity itself. ​

Built from the ground up with Unreal Engine 5, Gears of War: E-Day delivers unprecedented graphical fidelity.

games.name: Final Fantasy Resonance
games.summary: Return to the pixel‑art world of FINAL FANTASY, evolved from its classic roots. Travel with companions bound by fate and call on Visions to aid you in battle to uncover the truth behind a force that threatens to bring everything to ruin.
